newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's July iron output rises 8.9 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's July iron output rises 8.9 percent.

text.p: Peru's iron output rose 8.9 percent to 233,854 tonnes in July, compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from the Energy and Mines Ministry released Thursday.
Production fell 19.9 percent to 1.932 million tonnes in the first seven months of the year, compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.
Output of Peruvian iron dropped 14.33 percent last year to 3.897 million tons compared with 4.549 million tons in 1994.
Peru's only iron miner is Chinese-owned Shougang Hierro Peru S.A, a former state-owned firm privatized in November 1992.
